name: MicroVAST
full_name: MicroVAST robotic magnetic navigation platform (external permanent magnet on a robot arm, robotic ultrasound tracking)
group: Menciassi, The BioRobotics Institute, Scuola Superiore Sant'Anna
versions: 2012: wireless magnetic capsule dragged by an EPM on a 6-DoF arm, second arm holds the US probe (tognarelli2012_magnetic); 2015: 2D US tracking of soft-tethered devices on the MicroVAST platform (mura2015_ultrasound, abstract); 2016: 3D US tracking of a magnetic-dragged soft-tethered device (mura2016_computer, abstract)
target_anatomy: cardiovascular (atherosclerotic arteries, tognarelli2012_magnetic Introduction); listed as neuroendovascular in alekseeva2025_design Table 14
devices_driven: 2012: capsule 5 mm x 10.6 mm, 0.75 g, with an internal NdFeB N52 magnet of 6 tablets (3.2 mm x 1.6 mm) (tognarelli2012_magnetic Methods); 2015-16: soft-tethered endovascular device (dimensions N.R. in the abstracts)
n_dof_detail: 6 (alekseeva2025_design Table 14): Mitsubishi RV-3SB 6-DoF arm moves the EPM; RV-6SL 6-DoF arm moves the US probe (tognarelli2012_magnetic Methods)
translation_detail: magnetic (dragging by the moving external permanent magnet)
mass_kg: N.R. (EPM 0.4 kg, 51 mm diameter x 25 mm, tognarelli2012_magnetic Methods)
haptics_leader: Phantom Omni haptic input device moves the EPM arm (tognarelli2012_magnetic Methods)
imaging_compat: ultrasound: Esaote CA430E convex probe (3.5-5 MHz) on the second arm with real-time US servoing (tognarelli2012_magnetic); 3D US tracking (mura2016_computer)
validation_detail: soft-tethered device: tracking and locomotion tests on the platform (mura2016_computer abstract; phantom type N.R.; alekseeva2025_design: 'ex vivo phantom studies (TRL3)'). The 2012 tests used the untethered capsule: 300 mm path of Plexiglas tube, PVC tube and a freshly excised porcine vessel in a flow loop at 2.3, 3.1 and 3.7 L/min, with and against flow (tognarelli2012_magnetic Methods)
key_numbers: EPM NdFeB N52, remanence 1.48 T; arm drag speed 5 mm/s (tognarelli2012_magnetic Methods); 3D US tracking error 6.4 +/- 2.8 px, mean displacement from the pre-operative path 13.6 +/- 4.5 mm, 12.2 +/- 1.5 ms per frame (mura2016_computer abstract)
sim_model: none found (analytical magnetic and fluid-drag model, tognarelli2012_magnetic)

picture.credit: Tognarelli et al., Journal of Robotic Surgery (2011), Fig. 2. publisher copyright.

notes: Family: magnetic. The catheter-like device (soft-tethered) appears only in the 2015-16 papers, read as abstracts; Mura 2016 (T&F, CC BY-NC) and Mura 2015 (Wiley) are on the manual-download list and would decide the device size and test level. alekseeva2025_design Sec. 4 calls the field source an electromagnet; tognarelli2012_magnetic uses a permanent magnet.
